sloka: प्रयान्तं लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा द्वाःस्थो भरतमन्तिकात् ।उवाच भरतं तत्र वर्धयित्वा कृताञ्जलिः ।। ७.४४.६ ॥
transliteration: prayāntaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ dṛṣṭvā dvāḥstho bharatamantikāt ।uvāca bharataṁ tatra vardhayitvā kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। 7.44.6 ॥

translations.english: Having seen Lakshmana departing, the doorkeeper, from nearby, then greeted Bharata with folded hands and spoke to him.
